final_answer.key_evidence_summary: All pods scheduled on node worker-01 are stuck at Init:0/1 with no pod IP (adservice, cartservice, emailservice, productcatalogservice, shippingservice), while every pod on worker-02 is 2/2 Running with an IP. The pod events show the breakpoint: 'Warning FailedCreatePodSandBox ... Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = ... dial unix /run/containerd/containerd.sock: connect: no such file or directory'. Node/service checks discriminate the cause: GetClusterConfiguration shows worker-01 status NotReady (taints node.kubernetes.io/not-ready:NoSchedule/NoExecute) while master/worker-02/worker-03 are Ready; CheckNodeServiceStatus(worker-01, containerd) reports 'Active: inactive (dead) since Fri 2026-01-02 12:32:29 CST' and 'Stopped containerd container runtime', so the CRI socket is gone; kubelet is 'active (running)' on worker-01 but continuously logs 'dial unix /run/containerd/containerd.sock: connect: no such file or directory' and 'GenericPLEG: Unable to retrieve pods' (victim, not breakpoint); kube-proxy is active (running). Reachability confirms the impact: endpoints adservice = <none> while unaffected frontend = 172.20.2.68:8080. Root cause: containerd runtime unavailable on node worker-01, so pod sandboxes can never be created and services on that node have no ready endpoints.
